## Google Play Billing on Android
- Android apps (WebView player) can sell one-time products made in Play Console. Games call `IgniteAndroid.billingCall` with `products`, `buy`, `purchases` and `consume`, and every answer comes back to `window.__igBilling`.
- Purchases that finish outside a call (Google Play's purchase screen, or a pending payment that goes through later) arrive as an event. A purchase the game never got to is still there on the next start.
- It uses Google Play Billing Library 9.1, so Android builds now ask for the `BILLING` permission. The script editor's **API** panel describes the calls.

## Still not in this version
